{% raw %}
How to race in your league's championships.

## Your driver

Open **My profile**, then the **Sim Racing** tab, and add your driver: your name as it appears in the sim, your nationality, the car number you like, and your Steam id, iRacing customer id or EA, PSN or Xbox name. These are how your results find you.

## Entering

If entries are open, the standings post has a **📝 Enter** button: ask for a car number, a team and a class, and an officer approves it. Otherwise ask an officer to enter you.

## Signing up for a round

Each round's post has a button for each class (or one for the grid). Full-time drivers keep their seat whenever they sign up; reserves fill the seats full-timers give up, in the order they signed up, and get a direct message when they move up. Can't make it? Press **Won't attend** so a reserve gets your seat.

## Your results

On the standings post, **📊 My results** shows your points round by round, dropped rounds and any penalties. **🗓️ Results by round** shows a whole round.

## Reporting an incident

After a round starts, **🚩 Report an incident** on its post sends a report to the stewards: the session, the car numbers or drivers involved, when it happened, what happened and a video link if you have one. You can report until the window closes (48 hours after the round, unless your league changed it). The stewards discuss it and you get their decision by direct message.
